paragraphs.source_en: Konomi stiffly shuffled forward on her knees to Ieyasu's side and, as instructed, began massaging his greasy neck, her touch awkward and cold. Yet Konomi still found herself startled: beneath her fingertips she felt a faint, delicate pulse. What was he thinking, and what was he hoping for, that he had made her do this?

units.source_en: Konomi stiffly shuffled forward on her knees to Ieyasu's side and, as instructed, began massaging his greasy neck, her touch awkward and cold.

ja.t: つきはぎこちなく、よそよそしかった。

units.source_zh: 木实僵硬地膝行到家康身边，依言在他油腻的脖子上按起来，感觉生硬而冷漠。

units.source_en: Yet Konomi still found herself startled: beneath her fingertips she felt a faint, delicate pulse. What was he thinking, and what was he hoping for, that he had made her do this?

ja.t: にこんなことをさせているのだろう。

units.source_zh: 可是木实仍不知不觉吃了一惊，她的指尖感觉到纤细的脉搏，他究竟在想什么、在期待什么，才令她做这些？

paragraphs.source_zh: 木实僵硬地膝行到家康身边，依言在他油腻的脖子上按起来，感觉生硬而冷漠。可是木实仍不知不觉吃了一惊，她的指尖感觉到纤细的脉搏，他究竟在想什么、在期待什么，才令她做这些？

paragraphs.source_en: “You are quite practiced at this. Press a little harder.” He turned his head slightly to look at Konomi and murmured, “Haven't you noticed? Your hands are gradually growing warm. You are a woman after all.”

units.source_en: He turned his head slightly to look at Konomi and murmured, “Haven't you noticed? Your hands are gradually growing warm. You are a woman after all.”

ja.t: づいておらぬのか。そなたの
かくなってきた。やはり

units.source_zh: 他微微转过头看看木实，小声道，“你有未发现，你的手逐渐暖和起来，到底是女子。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你手法很熟啊。再用力些。”他微微转过头看看木实，小声道，“你有未发现，你的手逐渐暖和起来，到底是女子。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What?” At first, Konomi did not understand what he meant. When understanding dawned, she was suddenly overcome with embarrassment and instinctively raised a hand to her cheek; both her face and palm were burning hot. What was happening to her?

units.source_en: At first, Konomi did not understand what he meant.
units.source_zh: 起初木实不明白这句话的意思。

units.source_en: When understanding dawned, she was suddenly overcome with embarrassment and instinctively raised a hand to her cheek; both her face and palm were burning hot.

ja.t: ったとたん、ひどくうろたえ、

units.source_zh: 当她明白过来后，顿觉十分狼狈，不由伸手摸了摸脸颊，脸和手掌都如火烧般热。

ja.t: いったい、どうしたというのだろう。

paragraphs.source_zh: “啊？”起初木实不明白这句话的意思。当她明白过来后，顿觉十分狼狈，不由伸手摸了摸脸颊，脸和手掌都如火烧般热。这是怎么了？

paragraphs.source_en: Presently, Ieyasu began to snore softly. Konomi did not believe that he had truly fallen asleep. Her palms were growing steadily warmer. Perhaps he was only pretending to sleep on purpose... As the thought crossed her mind, the heat in her palms gradually spread through her entire body.

units.source_en: Presently, Ieyasu began to snore softly.
units.source_zh: 家康旋已发出轻微的鼾声。

units.source_en: Konomi did not believe that he had truly fallen asleep.
units.source_zh: 木实并不以为他已睡着。

units.source_en: Her palms were growing steadily warmer. Perhaps he was only pretending to sleep on purpose... As the thought crossed her mind, the heat in her palms gradually spread through her entire body.

ja.t: たふりをしているのかもしれない……そう

units.source_zh: 她的手掌逐渐热了起来，他许是故意装睡……这么想着，手掌的热逐渐扩散到全身。

paragraphs.source_zh: 家康旋已发出轻微的鼾声。木实并不以为他已睡着。她的手掌逐渐热了起来，他许是故意装睡……这么想着，手掌的热逐渐扩散到全身。

paragraphs.source_en: When a woman's body touched a man's, did it give rise to subtle feelings that ran contrary to her will? Konomi was plainly displeased at heart, yet without her realizing it, her body had kindled into flame and betrayed her. Perhaps Ieyasu knew this, and that was why he had deliberately refrained from arguing with her.

units.source_en: When a woman's body touched a man's, did it give rise to subtle feelings that ran contrary to her will?

ja.t: いてしまうものなのだろうか。

units.source_zh: 女人的身体接触到男子时，就会生出与意志相反的微妙情感吗？

units.source_en: Konomi was plainly displeased at heart, yet without her realizing it, her body had kindled into flame and betrayed her.
units.source_zh: 木实分明心中不乐，肉体却不知不觉燃起火焰，背叛了自己。

units.source_en: Perhaps Ieyasu knew this, and that was why he had deliberately refrained from arguing with her.

ja.t: っていたからこそ、わざと
さなかったのかもしれない。

units.source_zh: 或许家康知道这些，才故意没有拿话驳她。

paragraphs.source_zh: 女人的身体接触到男子时，就会生出与意志相反的微妙情感吗？木实分明心中不乐，肉体却不知不觉燃起火焰，背叛了自己。或许家康知道这些，才故意没有拿话驳她。

paragraphs.source_en: When a persimmon ripens, it naturally falls... Konomi could not help thinking of Hideyoshi and Chacha. She had heard that Chacha was now vying with Lady Matsumaru for Hideyoshi's favor. Were all women so pitiable?

units.source_en: When a persimmon ripens, it naturally falls... Konomi could not help thinking of Hideyoshi and Chacha.
units.source_zh: 柿子熟了，自然就会落下来……木实不由得想起秀吉和茶茶。

units.source_en: She had heard that Chacha was now vying with Lady Matsumaru for Hideyoshi's favor. Were all women so pitiable?

ja.t: れなものなのだろうか。

units.source_zh: 听说茶茶现在正和松丸夫人争宠，女人都这么可悲吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 柿子熟了，自然就会落下来……木实不由得想起秀吉和茶茶。听说茶茶现在正和松丸夫人争宠，女人都这么可悲吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Konomi's troubled fancies went on without end, while Ieyasu's snores grew ever louder, leaving her unable to fall asleep even by the third watch of the night.

units.source_en: Konomi's troubled fancies went on without end, while Ieyasu's snores grew ever louder, leaving her unable to fall asleep even by the third watch of the night.
units.source_zh: 木实妄想不止，而家康的鼾声越来越大，使得木实直到三更还未能入睡。

paragraphs.source_zh: 木实妄想不止，而家康的鼾声越来越大，使得木实直到三更还未能入睡。
